newsitem.title: USA: Catalyst Intl says charges hurt Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Catalyst Intl says charges hurt Q4 net.

text.p: Catalyst International Inc said restructuring and other charges adversely affected net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company reported a loss of $4.9 million in the period, compared with net income of $1.3 million one year ago. Without the $2.3 million in charges, the loss would have been $2.6 million, Catalyst International said.
Revenues in the period were #3.9 million, down from $6.7 million one year ago.
Catalyst International develops warehouse management software. Its shares closed down 1/8 Wednesday at 4-1/4.
